correctness.rationale: For GP(8,3), independently constructed all 1090 nonempty independent simplices with face vector (16,96,272,376,240,72,16,2), all 96 graph automorphisms, and cube quotient/4 antipodal pairs. Boundary ranks ∂4=181 and ∂5=58 mod101 match known rational homotopy ∨4S³∨S⁴. A nonzero degree-four cycle modulo im∂5 determines its sign b under all 96 automorphisms; signed Lefschetz fixed-face traces agree with b−b*sgn(pi)*Fix_D(pi), so χ3=b*sgn(pi)*Fix_D(pi). All 48 pairs (pi,b) occur twice, kernel {id,z}. Semisimplicity yields the stated rational H3 twisted permutation module and H4 sign line. Averaging over finite G and barycentric subdivision proves rational quotient invariants. No integral equivariant decomposition claimed.
